correctness.rationale: An explicit bijection between t-invariant subspaces and monic divisors yields all subalgebra coefficients; the ideal condition is im(T) inside the ideal intersection with V. A linear-fiber argument reduces nonabelian two-generator closures to cyclic polynomial modules; Euler polynomial totients give exact multiplicities. All quantifiers and excluded previously known nilpotent case are explicit. Eleven exhaustive prime-field tests independently enumerate subalgebras, ideals and every ordered pair; they supplement, not prove, the field-uniform theorem.

originality.rationale: Lee arXiv:2010.02268 already treats \(f=t^m\) and is explicitly excluded, and Brent–Gao–Lauder already give the Krylov endpoint probability, which is credited. Lee arXiv:2602.07254 treats solvable zeta functions through dimension four. The new statement treats unbounded-dimension nonnilpotent cyclic adjoint polynomials and determines two full Lie zeta polynomials plus every ordered-pair generated-subalgebra dimension. Comparable retrieved records address different objects/invariants; the residual chance of an equivalent unindexed module-theoretic Lie treatment is disclosed.
